description: This header file defines the class cSettings, which manages configuration settings by reading and writing key-value pairs to a file. It supports getting and setting values of different types, checking key existence, removing keys, and persisting changes to disk.

classes.name: cSettings
classes.description: A class for managing configuration settings stored as key-value pairs in a file, supporting operations like get, set, remove, and persistence.

methods.name: cSettings
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the settings object, reads from the file, or creates a new file if it does not exist.

methods.name: ~cSettings
methods.description: Default destructor for the cSettings class.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Retrieves the value associated with the specified key.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets the value for a given key, overloads support string, int, and bool types.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if a key exists and is non-empty in the settings data.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a key-value pair from the settings data.

methods.name: writeToFile
methods.description: Persists the current settings data to the associated file.

methods.name: readFromFile
methods.description: Initializes the settings data from the associated file.
